boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Oberlin College
boards.description: Current food and convenience options with published evening availability in Oberlin and the surrounding area.

cards.title: Stevenson Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: 155 N. Professor St., Oberlin
cards.notes: Check the dining page before heading over; weekday late-night service is listed separately from dinner and runs 9–11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining with a published weekday late-night window.
cards.evidence_claim: AVI lists Stevenson Dining Hall open Monday–Friday until 11 p.m., with late-night service from 9–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: AVI Serves Oberlin College — Dining & Meal Plans
cards.access_notes: Published weekday hours are 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m.; late night is 9–11 p.m. Check the live dining page for changes.

cards.title: Subway on South Main
cards.subtitle: 18 S Main St., Oberlin
cards.notes: Use pickup, delivery, or dine-in as available; the location publishes the same 11 p.m. closing time for every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A downtown sandwich stop with daily late evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official location page lists its 18 S Main St. Oberlin restaurant open 9 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published store hours: 9 a.m.–11 p.m. daily. The official page also lists pickup and delivery; confirm availability before ordering.

cards.title: The Feve kitchen
cards.subtitle: 30 S Main St., Oberlin
cards.notes: Use the restaurant kitchen hours rather than upstairs-bar hours; the dinner menu is published until 11 p.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant whose kitchen stays open into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Feve lists dinner-menu kitchen hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen closes at 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 9 p.m. Sunday, according to the restaurant. This card concerns restaurant food service.

cards.title: Lorenzo’s Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 52½ S Main St., Oberlin
cards.notes: Plan this for Friday or Saturday when the posted closing time extends to 10 p.m.; check the restaurant page for any temporary change.
cards.short_summary: A South Main pizzeria with later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Lorenzo’s official visit page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are until 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday. Verify before leaving.

cards.title: Pit Stop Mini Mart
cards.subtitle: 50470 U.S. 20, Oberlin
cards.notes: Use the drive-through mini mart for snacks, groceries, or hot food; weekday hours run later than the Sunday closing time.
cards.short_summary: A U.S. 20 convenience stop with hot food and evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pit Stop Ohio lists its Mini Mart at 50470 U.S. 20 open until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and selling snacks, groceries, pizza, wings, and more.
cards.access_notes: Published Mini Mart hours: 5:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Saturday, and 8 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: 1833 Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 10 E. College St., Oberlin
cards.notes: Use the publicly open restaurant for an evening meal; its FAQ gives current dinner service every day through 9 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Hotel at Oberlin restaurant with daily dinner service.
cards.evidence_claim: 1833 Restaurant says it is open to the public and lists dinner hours of 4–9 p.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published dinner hours are 4–9 p.m. daily. Reservations can be made through the restaurant’s listed channels.

cards.title: Subway at Walmart #5309
cards.subtitle: 46440 U.S. Route 20, Oberlin
cards.notes: This is a separate Subway location on U.S. 20; use its published 10 p.m. closing time and confirm service options directly.
cards.short_summary: A second Oberlin Subway with nightly 10 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official Oberlin locations page lists the Walmart #5309 location at 46440 U.S. Route 20 open until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 8 a.m.–10 p.m. daily. Check the official location page before making a special trip.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Oberlin Avenue
cards.subtitle: 3671 Oberlin Ave., Lorain
cards.notes: For a drive-through option beyond town, use the published drive-through schedule; dine-in hours end earlier than drive-through service.
cards.short_summary: A Lorain drive-through with service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through hours at 3671 Oberlin Ave. until 2 a.m. most nights and until 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published drive-through hours: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and until 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Leavitt
cards.subtitle: 940 N Leavitt Rd., Amherst
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the late window; the official location page lists service until 4:30 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: An Amherst drive-through with the latest published hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-through hours at 940 N Leavitt Rd. in Amherst until 4:30 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 940 North Leavitt Road, Amherst
cards.access_notes: Published drive-through hours are 7 a.m.–4:30 a.m. daily. Confirm operations and transportation plans before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Colorado Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1390 Colorado Ave., Lorain
cards.notes: Use the official Lorain location listing to check the current schedule; it identifies this drive-through as open late until 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: Another regional drive-through with a published 3 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Lorain locations page lists the location at 1390 Colorado Ave. as open until 3 a.m. and offering drive-through service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Lorain, Ohio
cards.access_notes: The official location list reports the site open until 3 a.m. Use Taco Bell’s individual store page to reconfirm before departure.
